'''M-03-21''' was a medical file regarding the injuries and [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of several workers in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] following a fire in the central shaft of Level 12, Sector B, after a processor ignited. Two workers succumbed to smoke inhalation, while six others were admitted to the [[Medcenter/Legends|infirmary]].
